entries.title: Editorial Studio language and layout simplified
entries.summary: The private Editorial Studio was revised into a more direct administrative interface. Philosophical and promotional wording was removed, section labels were shortened, vertical spacing was reduced, and the WordPress explanation was consolidated into one compact read-only tool panel. Drafting, ticker management, Source Manager controls, analytics, ledger attribution, WordPress write restrictions, and server-side authorization are unchanged. All 73 release tests passed before publication.
entries.sourceLabel: The Utopian Society private Editorial Studio

changes: Replaced the oversized editorial introduction with a compact title and status bar
Removed philosophical and promotional section wording
Consolidated the WordPress workflow explanation into a compact read-only tool panel
Reduced vertical spacing while preserving all controls
Preserved ledger attribution, read-only WordPress behavior, and server-side authorization
